method.class: Missingness-aware benchmark selection and held-out score prediction
method.description:
Scientific workload: pinned real MTEB embedding-model score matrices, not generative-LLM evaluations. Fixed 48-column task/language/split/primary-metric/dataset-revision panels; natural missingness; k=[1,2,4,8]; eight never-queryable audit columns; >=4 recorded audit cells and >=8 unqueried recorded cells at k=8. Two cases (model-group and name-defined-family-disjoint), three seeds, original/permuted arms, then one REQUIRED zero-weight reset-replay diagnostic episode, 13 episodes total. No optional additional replay is permitted. Search has 24 held-out rows and 73-76 historical rows; final has 48 held-out rows and 88-99 historical rows. Smoke has one case, 24 historical rows, two held-out rows, 16 columns, four audit columns and k=[1,2]; its three episodes are original, permuted, required replay. Supply workload dimensions/checkpoints through inputs, never through seeds.
Data policy: a fixed English task allowlist is curated from actual pinned source documents, selecting the revision with most allowlisted documents per source model (lexicographic revision tie-break). Before feature extraction, canonicalize complete raw JSON with sorted keys; Unicode NFC, CRLF->LF, per-line trailing whitespace removal; integer-valued floats canonicalized to integers and nonfinite raw measurements represented explicitly as null. Remove identity/runtime-only keys evaluation_time, kg_co2_emissions, mteb_version, model_name, model, model_id, model_revision, revision, timestamp, path, evaluation_time_per_sample, dataset_revision, dataset_id, date. Canonicalize mteb_dataset_name to task_name. Preserve complete score-bearing payloads and task/dataset context. Hash each complete normalized document and each complete raw document-set row independently of source ID; union rows sharing any such hash, then assign components deterministically by SHA256(sorted source IDs joined with | plus split-v1), sorted component index modulo five: 0/1 search, others final. Filter only raw-document coverage >=16 before partition. Verified normalized raw-document/row hash intersections empty; frozen per-plane SHA256 embeds this joint audited split without placing final hashes in search resources. Runtime rechecks its own artifact/document/row hashes and train/test identity/content disjointness. Preserve original raw-source byte checksums and source paths as provenance, not as RPC inputs. Only historical coverage selects panel/audit membership; test eligibility uses masks, never values/errors. Classification accuracy, clustering v_measure, retrieval ndcg_at_10 and reranking map have fixed [0,1] bounds; signed Spearman correlations map (x+1)/2. A present main_score must agree within 1e-5 with the declared primary metric. Incompatible dataset revisions remain distinct columns; no held-out extrema, imputed targets or leaderboard aggregates.
Method and limits: starter and native random-lowrank baseline actually execute masked alternating ridge factorization with historical-only 10% cell validation over ranks 2/4 and ridge 0.1/1, eight sweeps per validation fit, then 30 full-history fit sweeps. Starter selects by maximum latent posterior variance and ridge-conditions on each permitted acquired score. Native random-lowrank uses seeded random acquisition and the same true factorization/conditioning, not an alias. Separate correlation-cover baseline uses overlapping historical pairwise correlations shrunk by n/(n+10), greedy squared-correlation coverage and masked per-target ridge regression with mean-centered zero-imputation of missing predictors, fixed ridge 0.1. Historical means and observed-score copying are separate evaluator-owned constant/copy controls on the candidate's matched target sets. CPU-only NumPy suffices for these methods and alternatives in the canonical research scope. Internal sweep counts are advisory, not candidate-reported validity evidence. Evaluator validates legal selections, observed values, bounded predictions, matched controls and replay; it cannot prove inaccessible candidate internals. Source/mathematical method verification is additional publication evidence, never a self-report flag.
Controls frozen before scoring: historical means invariant under within-column observed-value derangements; copying depends only on authorized observed-score mean; useful cross-task advantage is hypothesized (not required) to attenuate under independently destroyed alignment; reset replay must reproduce selections and float32 predictions within absolute 1e-6. The actual candidate method runs both history arms, with identical seed, metadata, targets, masks, acquisition budgets and work allowance; no arm label crosses RPC. Construct nonidentity index derangements separately for every nonconstant historical column, verify actual value changes, identical marginal multisets/missing masks and at least two distinct effective mappings; reject constant/no-op controls. No claim follows from an incomplete control or positive penalty-induced gap. No adaptivity gate is added: observation-independent benchmark selection is legal.
Aggregation fixed before execution: target cells equally within model; model-group case models equally; family case models equally within each held-out name-family, then families equally. Average k equally (1/4 production, 1/2 smoke), seeds equally (1/3 production), cases equally (1/2 production). These linear fixed weights commute, and the implementation computes k-within-model before fixed family averaging. Baseline own acquisitions define its unqueried set; constant/copy share candidate selections. Common audit-panel per-model/k losses are retained in evaluator-owned evidence for matched-target comparisons. Original episodes define candidate and baseline MAEs; permuted episodes define permuted_mae; permutation_gap=permuted_mae-candidate_mae is descriptive only. combined_score=1-candidate_mae. Replay has zero score weight. Any failed entire episode or required baseline/control retains all five losses=1 at its full predeclared weight, never omitted/renormalized; missing replay fails validity. Evidence records one aggregate record per seed, including all cases/arms/failures and measured durations. Its solution fields are evaluator-owned observations, not candidate assertions. Runtime is not a scored metric and no canonical productive-work minimum exists.
RPC operation table per episode: reset=1, upload_start=1, upload_chunk=8 maximum, upload_commit=1, fit=1, row_start=R, observe=8R. Row-start selects the first benchmark; each observe returns the next selection and checkpoint prediction. Total=12+9R. Search R=24 gives 228*13=2964; final R=48 gives 444*13=5772. This same complete total is enforced by the evaluator and harness. Setup and commit are counted even with one actual chunk. Smoke R=2,kmax=2 gives (12+3R)*3=54 maximum; actual chunks may be fewer. No download/state-export operations exist. Matrix logical cap=32MiB, max_chunks=8, decoded chunk cap=4MiB, contiguous offsets, <f4 values plus uint8 masks, full prediction <=128 float32 entries. All transfer state is candidate-owned memory, never shared paths. Preflight actually serializes maximum-shape matrix requests, a maximum base64 chunk, reset/row/observe metadata and maximum response with compact UTF-8 JSON plus newline, a representative JSON RPC envelope and an additional 65536-byte framing/envelope reserve. All complete messages remain strictly below 67108864 bytes. Maximum-count protocol mock traces verify all 13 episodes against the operation table with eight valid subchunks per upload. Wire schema/integrity is separate from scientific claims.
Scheduling/resources: one monotonic invocation deadline from module startup, minus conservative broker/container startup reserve 60s search/90s final, and finalization reserve 20s. Three sequential productive methods per episode (random-lowrank, correlation-ridge, candidate) each reserve 15s search/30s final plus 1s cleanup; resets and dispatch/cleanup reserve 4s per episode globally, including diagnostic replay. Joint bounds: search=60+20+13*(4+3*(15+1))=756s<900; final=90+20+13*(4+3*(30+1))=1371s<1800. Smoke reserves 15s startup, 5s finalization, 5s per productive method and the same isolated paths, <=120s. RPC reset bound 2s; non-reset work is capped by method and global deadlines. Failed episodes continue remaining declared resets when transport survives. Native subprocess TERM wait .2s + KILL/reap .2s + bounded stderr drain .4s, with 2s episode overhead; baselines are bounded native evaluator loops, not subprocesses. Fake-clock tests exercise near-limit responses, mid-operation/reset timeouts and slow cleanup without starving resets or outputs. Baseline timing excludes reset/startup/import/output; no timeout penalty certifies productive completion. Native mode uses a fresh allowlisted environment, Python from TASK_PYTHON (sys.executable only when unset), shell=False, separate copied code (32MiB/2048 entries/5s bounded source copy), no-network seccomp, read-only Landlock ABI>=3 runtime/code allowlists, CPU affinity (1 evaluator/3 candidate), 8GiB address spaces, aggregate-thread CPU limits and kill/reap. Resolve interpreter command names before runtime allowlisting. Broker mode requires BOTH exact /broker-code/candidate_proxy.py and a nonempty AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_SOCKET, imports/calls only trusted handle in-process, with no child launch or peer telemetry. Production container isolation/all-thread accounting is harness-owned; no invented telemetry API. Linux x86_64 CPython3.11-3.13 supported; draft-tested CPython3.12.15 and NumPy2.2.6 manylinux wheel verified against PyPI metadata and installed offline in a temporary venv. No TeX toolchain or conference template is supplied as an inference dependency; downstream manuscript production must provision official latest-edition assets and compile PDF offline.
Separate predicates: search correct means own frozen-source/content/split checks, all scheduled episodes/baselines/canonical controls completed legally, exact reset transcript, finite bounded predictions, effective permutation, matched budgets and successful required reset replay. There is NO comparative search threshold or bounded calibration delegation in task.md; losing to any baseline or a nonpositive permutation gap is not a search veto. Final correct uses the same validity predicates on the sealed independent pool, NOT a publication-superiority threshold. Operational qualification feasible additionally requires ordinary non-smoke production completion in budget, independent of scientific competitiveness and replay agreement; qualification is emitted only for exact AGENTIC_TASK_QUALIFICATION=1. Publication claim assessment is separate: null/negative/conditional results are legitimate, superiority needs complete paired model/family-cluster uncertainty versus both random-lowrank and correlation-ridge on all-unqueried and common audit targets, multiplicity accounted for or exploratory labels, and supported control evidence. Never conclude learning from a changed state hash or schema-valid self-report.
Best-shot limitations: family annotation is an explicit name-defined lineage/owner proxy from source model IDs, not an independently verified genealogical separation; restrict corresponding claims. Fixed English-panel selection and recorded-entry availability induce coverage/MNAR bias. Cellwise historical validation is not a guarantee for family shift. The scaffold does not assert novelty, complete literature review, a causal mechanism, a universal sufficient k, generative-model generalization, a finished paper, conference compliance or completed scientific research. Those remain documented downstream evidence obligations. No forbidden-paper search was performed; only named MTEB source and authoritative NumPy package metadata were accessed.

search.precision: float64 fitting/metrics; finite little-endian float32 inline arrays; Linux x86_64 CPython 3.11-3.13; 1 evaluator core and 3 candidate cores, 8 GiB per role

protocol.promotion_rule: Harness-owned only: at most three scored search evaluations including interrupted runs; eligible iff search correct is true; rank by combined_score descending with earliest completed campaign index for exact ties. No comparative threshold. Freeze source/configuration before sealed final. Required replay diagnostic is already in each complete reset sequence; no additional optional replay or controller is implemented.

search_proxies.name: development_mteb_pool
search_proxies.preserves: Genuine pinned MTEB, raw-content-disjoint groups, missingness, two cases, all four k checkpoints, matched native baselines and canonical controls, fixed failure weights and CPU/RPC isolation.
search_proxies.omits: Sealed independent pool, final statistical seeds and final larger held-out row count; publication novelty/causal/superiority/paper claims are not certified.

search_proxies.name: draft_smoke
search_proxies.preserves: Identical evaluator loading, RPC, training/acquisitions, baselines, nonvacuous permutation, reset replay, metric and cleanup paths on genuine data with exact three-reset sequence.
search_proxies.omits: Production coverage, ordinary qualification, throughput or research claims; only exact AGENTIC_TASK_DRAFT_SMOKE=1 selects this reduced plumbing profile.

search_visible: Canonical research requirements, allowed starting literature, public provenance of the chosen MTEB revision/license, the candidate interface/method boundary, search-only historical inputs and task metadata, and workload settings necessary for the current episode. The candidate sees only source-independent row/task tokens and the selected new-model observations authorized by its k budget, never bulk test scores or evaluator resource paths.

After a counted search invocation, the optimizer may receive its declared scalar search metrics, search correctness diagnostics, and search-only aggregate error-versus-k/control/failure summaries. This is optimizer feedback between episodes/evaluations, not baseline outputs, metrics, or correctness fields injected into candidate RPC. At most three cycles with one candidate evaluation each; no added comparison trials, extra replay evaluations, or final-driven tuning.

The deterministic eligibility/ranking/tie/freeze rule, hard resource/RPC limits, advisory nature of internal iteration limits, and permitted plane-independent request semantics. Starter code handles arbitrary reset seeds and request-defined workloads, without final-seed constants, final manifests, or seed-dependent plane selection.
final_sealed: Concrete final seeds, complete final and final-smoke reset transcripts, final pool membership/manifests and normalized raw content hashes, final targets and unacquired scores, family/test partitions, scoring masks/weights, evaluator-private calibration/probe values, and final reference outputs. These privileged design/contract values are unavailable during search; after freeze reveal only episode inputs authorized by the observation policy, not the private artifacts themselves.

All final scalar metrics, paired/bootstrap uncertainty, common-panel comparisons, control validity/outcomes, correctness decisions, failure evidence, resource attestations, and publication claim assessment remain sealed from optimization. A controlled publication review may inspect them after freeze; they never enter handle(request), another search evaluation, or a candidate edit.

required_evidence: A complete research paper, compiled PDF and LaTeX sources using the latest officially available NeurIPS main-track template verified at paper preparation, respecting its actual page rules and accompanying checklist, plus all implementation/reproduction code. Include abstract, introduction, related work, method, experiments, discussion/limitations, and real references actually consulted. Verify official template provenance and availability downstream rather than inventing a template revision or result during design. Every number/table/figure must be regenerated by the supplied code from actual runs; unfinished experiments, rejected approaches, failures, and negative results must be explicitly labeled.

Independent-research compliance: do not attempt to identify, search for, access, read, or use the forbidden existing paper, its metadata/abstract/mirrors/materials/code, or pages citing/discussing/reproducing it. Use the canonical permitted starter literature and unrelated allowed sources only. If prohibited material is encountered accidentally, stop reading immediately and truthfully record where, what, and how much was seen. No claim that a cited source was read is permitted without actually reading it.

The later standard scaffold and validated contract must bind the canonical task digest, candidate interface and edit boundary, actual upstream revision/license/entrypoints, standard dependency/artifact digests and offline-installable environment, independent evaluate.py/evaluate_final.py entrypoints, resources/search and resources/final roots, fixed seeds, baselines, failure weights, metrics, promotion/freeze policy, and exact production/smoke reset arrays. Use standard scaffold files rather than new support/lock files. Any genuinely necessary nonstandard support artifact discovered downstream must have a concrete task-relative path, actual SHA-256 and declared contract provenance, with the contract resynchronized after changes; this plan does not create such artifacts.

An actual source-to-row audit: pinned raw MTEB documents, source IDs and revisions, original file digests, fixed pre-feature text/JSON normalization, normalized content hashes for raw documents and complete examples excluding identity-only aliases, duplicate components, family annotation rules, canonical task/language/metric identities, primary metric bounds, missing masks, and immutable split manifests. Demonstrate zero normalized-content overlap across all search and final training/test resources, and group/family separation within applicable cases. Different directories or dataset IDs alone are insufficient. Record coverage attrition, natural missingness, dense-row eligibility bias, and exclusion of unbounded/incompatible metrics. Shared immutable code/weights are not held-out examples.

Executable source and trusted behavioral/reference checks showing real masked low-rank fitting, greedy information-based benchmark selection, ridge-conditioned updates after acquired scores, and the genuinely separate native baselines. State fitting assumptions, rank/ridge tuning on historical-only validation, clipping/normalization, computational cost, and the distinction between selecting whole benchmarks and selecting examples inside one benchmark. Any formal analysis must disclose its assumptions and be checked against actual data rather than substitute for empirical evidence.

Before scoring, freeze the control plan, intended invariances/degradations, all case/seed/k/model/family weights, unavailable-data handling, finite worst-case penalties, tolerances, and statistical comparison plan. Retain constant and observed-copy controls, verified nonidentity/effective within-column permutation controls running the actual candidate method, and the sole trailing reset replay. Supply matched inputs/budgets, transformed-value checks, complete control/episode logs, and exact invocation-wide broker reset transcripts including restarts/connections. A no-op control, omitted failure, or renormalized surviving subset cannot support a causal or comparative statement.

Downstream payload and compute preflight must serialize representative largest production requests and responses, count UTF-8 JSON, base64 expansion, metadata/envelope and framing, and verify each complete message is strictly below 64 MiB. Validate bounded in-memory chunk assembly and account for every chunk RPC in the plane broker ceiling; prove no evaluator paths, basenames, file handles, target arrays, reference outputs, correctness, or sealed feedback cross RPC. Obtain harness-owned CPU/thread/memory/wall and isolation attestations without inventing candidate telemetry APIs. Explicitly label internal sweeps/objective counts as advisory, distinct from enforced wall/RPC/all-thread CPU limits.

Offline empty-HOME smoke validation of both planes through the same real-source loader, candidate RPC, fitting/update, baseline/control, metric, and cleanup paths under the declared isolated CPU topology, plus exact smoke reset transcripts. Use smoke to check bounded feasibility and calibrate downstream RPC subdeadlines without claiming measured full-production throughput. Production evidence must separately demonstrate complete substantive case/seed/k coverage, required baselines, failures and cleanup within the plane budgets, the campaign ceiling of three candidate evaluations, storage below 5 GB, and the one-week overall research deadline including reading, preparation, experiments, analysis and writing.

One exact finite scalar metrics.json per plane invocation and trusted detailed per-model/k/case/family/seed evidence with fixed aggregation and finite failed contributions. Report all-unqueried-target MAE, common-audit-panel comparisons to control selection-dependent target difficulty, baseline results, the error-versus-k curve and observed evaluation-cost savings, paired family/model-cluster uncertainty, multiplicity treatment, coverage and failure counts. Do not infer a sufficient k without stating an application tolerance; report a tolerance/error frontier instead of inventing a universal threshold. Distinguish genuinely run leaderboard-matrix experiments from any optional, explicitly labeled synthetic diagnostic.

A frozen-source/configuration digest and campaign decision record demonstrating eligibility based on integrity/scientific-validity gates, ranking by declared higher-is-better combined_score, deterministic earliest-evaluation tie-breaking, and freeze before final exposure. Separately report search correct, final correct, and publication claim assessment. Superiority requires complete matched evidence against random-low-rank and correlation-ridge on both all-unqueried and common-panel losses with appropriate uncertainty; lack of superiority is a legitimate negative result, not a retroactive search veto. Restrict conclusions to the evaluated MTEB embedding models, held-out regimes, k range, and observed-data coverage. Include honest limitations on model-family shifts, missing-not-at-random records, benchmark noise, novelty relative to allowed literature, and generalization to generative language models.

Reproduction instructions must list exact runtime/dependency versions, allowed data-acquisition commands and licenses, canonical pinned source revision, normalized-content/split-manifest verification, statistical seeds and reset order, candidate freeze identity, hard versus advisory budgets, offline run commands and actual/expected runtimes clearly distinguished, and the script producing every paper table/figure. No artifact, launch, benchmark value, successful validation, throughput, or checkpoint is asserted to exist by this design; these are downstream evidence obligations.
